verdicts.reason: None of the San Francisco documents (D078–D083) addresses application or screening fees. The retrieved fee passages cover Berkeley (D005), California Civil Code 1950.6 text (D026/DX08) and Massachusetts (DX13). None of them states that San Francisco lacks or is barred from such a rule.

No document says San Francisco has no screening restriction. D078 actually points the other way: it says San Francisco's Fair Chance Ordinance protects residents with arrest or conviction history in affordable housing decisions. That suggests a rule may exist, but the documents give no details of its scope, so a no_rule verdict is not supported.
